title: Bridging Exploration and Persona: Information-Directed Dueling for Test-Time Agent Personalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.24385v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Effective test-time personalization requires LLM agents to adapt to query-dependent user preferences from lightweight interaction. We study persona selection with binary comparisons between candidate responses as the online signal. We present ID-TAP, a scalable, IDS-inspired neural dueling-bandit framework for large discrete persona spaces. ID-TAP combines a query-conditioned neural utility model with a lightweight Bradley-Terry explorer, and transfers comparison evidence across related queries through similarity-weighted warm starts. The neural model shares statistical strength across queries while preserving query-specific scores, and efficient BT updates score hypothetical challengers. Across seven user-conditioned generation benchmarks under reference- and model-based preference simulators, ID-TAP achieves the strongest aggregate performance among the evaluated baselines within a fixed ten-round comparison budget. translated_title: 融合探索与用户画像：面向测试时代理个性化的信息导向决斗方法
translated_abstract: 有效的测试时个性化要求大语言模型（LLM）代理通过轻量级交互来适应依赖于查询的用户偏好。我们研究以候选回答之间的二元比较作为在线信号的个性化画像选择问题。我们提出了ID-TAP，一个可扩展的、受信息导向采样（IDS）启发的神经决斗老虎机框架，适用于大型离散的画像空间。ID-TAP将查询条件化的神经效用模型与轻量级的Bradley-Terry探索器相结合，并通过相似度加权的预热启动在相关查询之间传递比较证据。神经模型在多个查询之间共享统计信息，同时保留查询特定的评分，高效的BT更新则为假想的挑战者打分。在基于参考和基于模型的偏好模拟器下，跨越七个用户条件化的生成基准，ID-TAP在固定的十轮比较预算内取得了所评估基线中最强的总体性能。这些结果表明……
tldr: 提出ID-TAP框架，将查询条件化的神经效用模型与轻量级Bradley-Terry探索器相结合，利用相似度加权的跨查询证据迁移，在十轮比较预算内实现了大语言模型代理在测试时的最优个性化画像选择。
en_tdlr: ID-TAP is an information-directed neural dueling-bandit framework that combines a query-conditioned utility model with a lightweight Bradley-Terry explorer to achieve the strongest aggregate performance for test-time LLM agent personalization within a fixed ten-round comparison budget.
